changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0073. Staff leave requests with tenant isolation, date ranges, optional attachment, and decision audit. Index review: PK on Id; UX_StaffLeave_Pending_Staff_Range prevents overlapping pending/approved rows per staff when active; IX_StaffLeaveRequests_Tenant_Dates and IX_StaffLeaveRequests_Staff serve calendar and my-leaves queries. Performance note: every list filter leads with TenantId.
changeSet.sql: SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON; IF OBJECT_ID(N'app.StaffLeaveRequests', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE app.StaffLeaveRequests ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, StaffProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, LeaveType NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, StartDate DATE NOT NULL, EndDate DATE NOT NULL, DurationDays INT NOT NULL, Reason NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, AttachmentFileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, ApprovalRequestId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, SubmittedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DecisionComment NVARCHAR(500) NULL, DecidedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, DecidedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_StaffLeaveRequests PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_StaffLeaveRequests_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_StaffLeaveRequests_StaffProfiles FOREIGN KEY (StaffProfileId) REFERENCES app.StaffProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_StaffLeaveRequests_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_StaffLeaveRequests_Dates CHECK (EndDate >= StartDate), CONSTRAINT CK_StaffLeaveRequests_Duration CHECK (DurationDays > 0), CONSTRAINT CK_StaffLeaveRequests_Type CHECK (LeaveType IN (N'Annual', N'Sick', N'Casual', N'Unpaid', N'Other')), CONSTRAINT CK_StaffLeaveRequests_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Pending', N'Approved', N'Rejected', N'Cancelled')) ); CREATE INDEX IX_StaffLeaveRequests_Tenant_Dates ON app.StaffLeaveRequests (TenantId, StartDate, EndDate) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_StaffLeaveRequests_Staff ON app.StaffLeaveRequests (TenantId, StaffProfileId, Status) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_StaffLeaveRequests_Approval ON app.StaffLeaveRequests (TenantId, ApprovalRequestId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND ApprovalRequestId IS NOT NULL; END;
